India Loses Football Match to Brazil 4-0

The Indian football team played against Brazil for the first time and lost the match 4-0. Brazil took a lead in the 29th minute with a goal, and the Indian team was unable to make a comeback. Pedro and Lino were noted for their performance for Brazil.
